questions.prompt: Solve x double prime plus omega squared x equals zero.
questions.answer: Try x=e^{rt}. Then x prime is r e^{rt} and x double prime is r squared e^{rt}. Substitute: \[r^2e^{rt}+\omega^2e^{rt}=0\] Factor e^{rt}: \[(r^2+\omega^2)e^{rt}=0\] Since e^{rt} is not zero, \[r^2+\omega^2=0\] so r=plus or minus i omega. The real solution is \[x(t)=C_1\cos\omega t+C_2\sin\omega t\]
